description.value: House a second soul in the same item. Both item bonuses apply, to two different skills or saves. Temper rises twice as fast — every trigger raises it by 2 — because two souls in one housing have never once agreed about whose item it is.

cinderfall.incomplete: Housing a second bound soul, applying two item bonuses, and doubling Temper's rise rate are all built on Temper and soul-binding, Cinderfall's own subsystem with no representation anywhere in the actor schema -- there is no 'Temper' attribute or roll option for a rule element to read or modify.
